summary: Invardia can now see the state of a private install's update build resources.

new.title: Private install build state reported
new.text: An install on a private network now tells Invardia the state of the resources it uses to build updates. Other installs send nothing for this.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes: zero counts reported correctly
fixes.text: A count of zero in the health report to Invardia is no longer dropped as empty.
